idea-plugin.name: Project Tiles
idea-plugin.description:
A lightweight tile dashboard for your projects, in its own editor tab and on the welcome screen.
  • Tiles with name, description and logo (emoji, image file, or an auto-detected logo.png / icon.png)
  • Collections with colours; drag & drop to reorder projects and collections
  • Git branch, last commit, an ahead/behind badge and fetch / pull / push buttons per repository
  • Add several projects at once from the IDE's recent-projects list
  • Projects on a disconnected drive are greyed out; deleted folders are flagged
  • Languages like on GitHub (weighted by bytes), with a manual override
  • One project list shared with the Project Tiles extension for VS Code and its forks

No telemetry. The only network traffic is git fetch in your own repositories, which can be turned off.

Free and open source: source code. If it saves you time, you can support it through GitHub Sponsors.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.2.0: per-project overrides for showing the path, description, languages and git status on its tile, on top of the global settings; a new global setting for the description.

1.1.0: fetch / pull / push buttons on tiles; add several recent projects at once; projects on a disconnected drive are greyed out and deleted folders are flagged; options to hide the path, languages or git status; smaller buttons; "Add current folder" no longer shows on the welcome screen.

1.0.2: fixes the dashboard not opening in 2026.2 IDEs.

1.0.1: link to GitHub Sponsors.

1.0.0: first public release.
